remarks: Rarely available end-unit townhouse in prime Norwalk location, complete with a 2-car garage and a brand-new 2024 HVAC system with a 10-year warranty. Additional recent upgrades include a newer washer, dryer, dishwasher, refrigerator, and hot water heater-all replaced within the last three years for true move-in peace of mind. Just minutes to the train, major highways, beaches, and all the shopping and waterfront dining SoNo has to offer, this impeccably maintained 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home delivers effortless living with low $275/month common charges. Enjoy the bright open-concept living/dining area, central air, and the convenience of 2nd-floor laundry. Don't miss this turn-key opportunity! Norwalk is in year three of a 5 year tax phase in.
